about_blocks.text: Last Door provides addiction recovery services for youth and adult males between the ages of 13-30. The facility offers private medical detox services, residential recovery programs, and family focus enhancement programs for partners, parents, grandparents, and siblings. Their programs address mental health and substance abuse issues and aim to lift the burden of addiction from their clients’ lives. The average stay at the facility is between 3-5 months.

about_blocks.text: Last Door’s Long Term Transitional Living Program
about_blocks.html: Last Door’s Long Term Transitional Living Program

about_blocks.text: Many residents of Last Door also avail of the facility’s long term transitional living program which spans up to a year. This program offers a unique and comprehensive wrap-around service that includes access to room and board, employment assistance, education support, positive peer support, and case management. The client’s medical and clinical progress is continuously monitored and supported through weekly visits from professionals. The goal of the program is to provide long-term support so that clients can maintain recovery and develop an independent and fulfilling life outside of the facility.

about_blocks.text: Last Door Recovery Society is considered the Recovery Capital of Canada, and they attribute it to their use of Recovery Capital software, a health-care movement that views clients as a whole. The software measures and monitors clients during post-treatment to assess and build their recovery capital. Clients use their own tablet each week to review their Recovery Capital Assessment and weekly recovery goals, which help Last Door identify areas for improvement.

about_blocks.text: Last Door operates in an urban area and provides a home-like setting for their clients. Aside from the programs mentioned above, Last Door also incorporates practical life skills and supervised daily activity in their programs to help clients connect with their sense of responsibility. Clients are encouraged to develop peer support and camaraderie through group work, directed interventions, peer support, and written exercises. Therapeutic groups explore themes of loss, self-esteem, communication, stress, sleep enhancement, anger, leisure and recreation, relationships, and anxiety management. Family work and discharge planning are also integral components of the program.

about_blocks.text: Last Door Recovery Society is a leading rehab centre located in Metro Vancouver that specializes in delivering comprehensive addiction recovery services. Catering to individuals and families who are struggling with drug and alcohol addiction, Last Door is a fully licensed and accredited facility that has been providing these services for over 35 years. The team of highly qualified and experienced professionals at Last Door is committed to offering a compassionate and supportive environment that is founded on principles such as trust, faith, diversity, and integrity, among others.

With a strong track record of success, Last Door is a trusted resource for individuals and families seeking specialized and personalized addiction treatment services.
